english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or thing that is amusingly quirky and unconventional.
Use this for a person, mannerism, or style that is weird in a playful, lively, or appealingly cute way.

examples.english: Your son is really zany; he is always coming up with odd ideas.
examples.traditional: 你個仔真係古靈精怪，成日諗埋啲古怪橋。
examples.jyutping: nei5 go3 zai2 zan1 hai6 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3 seng4 jat6 nam2 maai4 di1 gu2 gwaai3 kiu4

examples.english: My little sister is always coming up with quirky ideas.
examples.traditional: 我個細妹成日諗埋啲古靈精怪嘅橋。
